artifacts.summary: 12 raw-constructor witness-construction sites migrated to the SchemaUnion bridge (schemaUnion_kTags_iff_KAxiom.mp / schemaUnion_tTags_iff_TAxiom.mp / schemaUnion_s4Tags_iff_S4Axiom.mp over a directly-constructed SchemaUnion existential witness); 2 docstrings updated for accuracy; 1 new public import of SchemaBridges.lean.
Phase 6 and all three sub-phases marked [COMPLETED] with site enumeration, 3-cluster partition, and ground-truth deviation from the ~36 estimate recorded.
H9 orchestrator handoff for Phase 6, pointing to Phase 7 next.

memory_candidates: When a plan estimates N sites for a hand-migration phase, ground-truth the count via grep at dispatch start before partitioning into clusters -- IntToClassical.lean's Phase 6 estimate was ~36 sites but the real in-scope count was 12; the difference was entirely arms of match-statements on permanently out-of-scope inductive families that never need touching.

SchemaUnion witness migration pattern for a retired-in-Phase-8 raw constructor: replace `<Sys>Axiom.ctor args` with `schemaUnion_<sys>Tags_iff_<Sys>Axiom.mp <SchemaUnion witness>`, where the witness is `⟨.ctor, by decide, args, rfl⟩` -- this closes with a bare rfl because ModalSchemaTag.Holds is deliberately byte-identical in shape to each retired constructor's argument (design invariant 3 of the schema-union rollout).
